verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official CLI (Ruby gem) for various Honeybadger-related programs/utilities, confirmed by probe evidence, though it appears scoped to Ruby users and details on AI-native workflow support (e.g., scripting agent tasks, non-Ruby installs) are thin. missing for 10: broader language/platform coverage beyond Ruby gem, deeper documentation of CLI commands, independent hands-on confirmation of CLI usability for AI-native workflows.
